teaser: You are carrying someone else's boxes up three flights before your own are even out of the car. Later, your own stay half-unpacked for a month. Life path 6 is the number of the household's quiet keeper, the one who notices who hasn't eaten; INFP is the type that feels before it reasons, loyal to a private sense of what's right. Crossed, the two make a particular kind of caretaking — not performed, not transactional, but harder to set down than either alone would suggest. You tend what you love first, and sometimes tend it instead of asking what you love.
excerpt: The smell of coffee gone lukewarm in a hotel lobby, waited in for an hour because a partner's flight was delayed and you didn't want to leave in case they needed you right at that door.
